Title: FTX websockets stream on perpetual very slow 
Description: - OS: Windows
- Programming Language version: Python 3.9.13
- CCXT version: ccxtpro 1.2.10

The data recieved from ftx perp pairs is once every 2 seconds(roughly). Which is extremely slow comparing it to the regular BTC/USD pair on FTX which averaged out to 0.053 seconds over a 20 min sample (which in my experience is still on the slow side). I was wondering why it is taking roughly 2 seconds per tick and if i could do anything to make this a lot quicker. Let me know, appreciate your time.
